sources.title: 同人用語の基礎知識 — アヘ顔
sources.supports: Community description includes more than one eye configuration and a large open-mouth variant; related event-label usages are not identical in every context.
sources.limits: One community glossary, not prevalence data. Korean transliterations need mapping review. No media collected or event/consent inferred.

sources.title: 同人用語の基礎知識 — トロ目
sources.supports: Partly open/upward eyes and heart marks or highlights are discussed; similar visible eyes also occur in ordinary contexts.
sources.limits: トロ目 is an eye term, not automatically the full-face term トロ顔. No facial movement proves an internal state. No media collected.

sources.title: JapanDict — イキ顔 (JMdict 2856675)
sources.supports: Lexical event-label meaning for a facial expression; dictionary definition provides no fixed mouth, eye, or tongue geometry.
sources.limits: JMdict mirror, not a second independent lexicon. Korean spellings and variants remain translation mappings.

sources.title: Wiktionary — DILF
sources.supports: Attraction label for a father or older man.
sources.limits: Does not require a fixed muscle, hair, clothing, expression or confirmed parental status from pixels.
